title: Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta
subtitle: An early Buddhist discourse in the tradition of the first turning at Sarnath
timeLabel: Early Buddhist transmission; textual formation is not the same as the Buddha's lifetime
shortSummary: The Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta preserves a transmitted discourse tradition in which the Buddha teaches the five mendicants at Sarnath.
curatorialDescription: The museum presents ‘the Buddha taught’ as a transmitted and compiled textual layer, not as a modern recording or verbatim stenographic transcript.
researchNote: The text, its language, recitation and compilation history must be connected separately to Sarnath's archaeology and later Chinese translation traditions.

sources.title: Early Buddhist texts in the Pāli canon: MN 26 and SN 56.11
